title: Missing authorization in Kibana Cases alert attachments can allow an authenticated user with permission to add case…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in Kibana Cases alert attachments allows authenticated users with permission to add case comments or attachments to modify case-link metadata in documents they should not access. This can enable attackers to add false case links and exhaust the alert's case-link limit, disrupting legitimate case linkage. The vulnerability affects the kibana.alert.case_ids field in indices accessible by Kibana's internal account. Partial fixes were applied in versions 8.19.22, 9.4.8, and 9.5.5, with the advisory's fixed versions addressing both authorization defects.
